```{r}
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE))

library(broom)
library(data.table)
library(tidyverse)
library(extrafont)
library(ggsegGlasser)
library(ggseg)

source("R/plotting.R")
source("R/rainclouds.R")
source("R/utils.R")
setwd("data/")

dt_long <- readRDS("gradients_df.RDS")

df_wide <- dcast(dt_long,
                 subject + group + region + age + sex + hemi + yeo ~ gradient,
                 value.var = "gradient_score")

dt_yeo <- dt_long %>%
  expand(nesting(region, yeo))
```

```{r}
cmap_yeo <- c("#781286", "#4682B4", "#00760E", "#C43AFA", "#DCF8A4", "#E69422", "#CD3E4E")

yeo_plot <- ggplot(data = dt_yeo) +
  geom_brain(atlas = glasser,
             position = position_brain(side ~ hemi),
             aes(fill = yeo)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cmap_yeo) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cmap_yeo)
yeo_plot
```

```{r}
dt_region <- dt_long[, .(centroid = mean(gradient_score)), by = .(yeo, subject, group, gradient, region)]

gradient_labels <- c(gradient_1 = "Gradient 1",
                     gradient_2 = "Gradient 2",
                     gradient_3 = "Gradient 3")

grad_plot <- ggplot(dt_region, aes(x = centroid, y = yeo, fill = yeo, color = yeo, alpha = group)) +
  ggridges::geom_density_ridges(scale = 2, show.legend = FALSE) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.grid = element_blank()) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12, family = "Calibri Light")) +
  xlab("gradient score") +
  ylab(element_blank()) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(CB = 0.4, SC = 0.8)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = cmap_yeo) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cmap_yeo) +
  facet_wrap(~ gradient, scales = "free_x",
             labeller = labeller(gradient = gradient_labels)) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
grad_plot
```

```{r}
sum_group <- dt_long[, .(mean_grad = mean(gradient_score)), by = .(group, yeo, region, gradient)]
sum_group_w <- dcast(sum_group, group + region + yeo ~ gradient, value.var = "mean_grad")

grad_plot12 <- create_grad_plot(sum_group_w, gradient_1, gradient_2, "Gradient 1", "Gradient 2")
grad_plot12
```

```{r}
grad_plot13 <- create_grad_plot(sum_group_w, gradient_1, gradient_3, "Gradient 1", "Gradient 3")
grad_plot13
```

# group differences - gradient 1

```{r paged.print = FALSE}
sum_group <- dt_long[, .(mean_grad = mean(gradient_score)), by = .(group, yeo, region, gradient)]
sum_group_w <- dcast(sum_group, group + region + yeo ~ gradient, value.var = "mean_grad")

stats_error <- dt_long %>%
  group_by(region, hemi, yeo, gradient, stream) %>%
  do(tidy(t.test(gradient_score ~ group, data = .))) %>%
  dplyr::select(estimate, parameter, statistic, p.value) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(gradient) %>%
  mutate(p_adjust = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(p_adjust < 0.05) %>%
  mutate_if(is.numeric, round, digits = 3) %>%
  mutate(region = factor(region)) %>%
  arrange(yeo)

diff_regions <- sum_group %>%
  left_join(stats_error, by = c("region", "yeo", "gradient")) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(estimate))

stats_g1 <- stats_error %>%
  dplyr::filter(gradient == "gradient_1") %>%
  arrange(yeo, stream) %>%
  print(n = 100)

setwd("../results")
write.csv(stats_g1, "stats_g1.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
diff_regions_g1 <- right_join(sum_group_w, stats_g1, by = c("region", "yeo"))
group_diff_g1_plot <- create_diff_plot(sum_group_w, gradient_1, gradient_2, diff_regions_g1, "Gradient 1", "Gradient 2")
group_diff_g1_plot
```

```{r}
group_diff_g1_plot2 <- create_diff_plot2(sum_group[gradient == "gradient_1", ], diff_regions[gradient == "gradient_1", ], "gradient score G1")
group_diff_g1_plot2
```

```{r}
group_diff_g1_plot3 <- create_diff_plot3(diff_regions[gradient == "gradient_1", ])
group_diff_g1_plot3
```

# Figure 1

```{r}
cowplot::set_null_device(cairo_pdf)

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(grad_plot12 +
                                theme(legend.title = element_blank()))

first_row <-
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    yeo_plot,
    NULL,
    legend,
    NULL,
    grad_plot12 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
    labels = c("A", "", "", "", "C"),
    label_size = 12,
    rel_widths = c(1.25, 0.05, 0.5, 0.05, 2),
    ncol = 5
  )

second_row <-
  cowplot::plot_grid(
    grad_plot,
    NULL,
    grad_plot13 + theme(legend.position = "none"),
    labels = c("B", "", ""),
    label_size = 12,
    rel_widths = c(1.8, 0.05, 2),
    ncol = 3
  )

third_row <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  group_diff_g1_plot3, NULL, group_diff_g1_plot2 + theme(legend.position = "none"), NULL, group_diff_g1_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
  group_diff_g2_plot3, NULL, group_diff_g2_plot2 + theme(legend.position = "none"), NULL, group_diff_g2_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
  group_diff_g3_plot3, NULL, group_diff_g3_plot2 + theme(legend.position = "none"), NULL, group_diff_g3_plot + theme(legend.position = "none"),
  labels = c("D", "", "", "", "",
             "", "", "", "", "",
             "E", "", "", "", "",
             "", "", "", "", "",
             "F", "", "", "", ""),
  label_size = 12,
  rel_widths = c(1.25, 0.05, 0.5, 0.05, 2),
  rel_heights = c(1, 0.05, 1, 0.05, 1),
  ncol = 5,
  align = "v")

all_figs <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  first_row,
  NULL,
  second_row,
  NULL,
  third_row,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(1, 0.05, 1, 0.05, 3)
)

setwd("../publications/figures")

cowplot::set_null_device(cairo_pdf)
ggsave(
  all_figs,
  filename = "figure_1.pdf",
  device = cairo_pdf,
  height = 30,
  width = 25,
  units = "cm",
  bg = "transparent",
  dpi = "print"
)

tiff(
  "figure_1.tiff",
  height = 30,
  width = 25,
  units = "cm",
  compression = "lzw",
  res = 500,
  type = "cairo",
  bg = "white"
)
all_figs
dev.off()
```

# Structure-Function Coupling

```{r}
setwd("../data/")
sfc <- fread("sfc.csv")
glasser <- fread("gradient_data/glasser360NodeNames.txt", header = FALSE)
sfc$roi <- glasser
sfc[, hemi := sapply(str_split(roi, "_"), `[`, 1)]
sfc[hemi == "Left", hemi := "left"]
sfc[hemi == "Right", hemi := "right"]
sfc[, region := sapply(str_split(roi, "_"), `[`, 2)]
rm(glasser)
```

```{r}
pca_sc <- ggplot(data = sfc) +
  geom_brain(atlas = glasser,
             position = position_brain(side ~ hemi),
             aes(fill = pca_sc)) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "blue", mid = "grey", high = "red",
                       limits = c(-1200, 8000)) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm")) +
  theme(legend.key.width = unit(0.25, "cm")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12, family = "Calibri Light")) +
  labs(fill = "pca\nscore") +
  ggtitle("SC")

```

# pca all figs

```{r}
cowplot::set_null_device(cairo_pdf)

legend_pca <- cowplot::get_legend(pca_sc)
legend_g1 <- cowplot::get_legend(sfc_g1_sc)
legend_diff_g1 <- cowplot::get_legend(diff_g1)
legend_g2 <- cowplot::get_legend(sfc_g2_sc)
legend_g3 <- cowplot::get_legend(sfc_g3_sc)

pca_all <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  pca_sc + theme(legend.position = "none"), legend_pca, pca_cb + theme(legend.position = "none"), NULL, NULL, NULL,
  NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
  sfc_g1_sc + theme(legend.position = "none"), legend_g1, sfc_g1_cb + theme(legend.position = "none"), NULL, diff_g1 + theme(legend.position = "none"), legend_diff_g1,
  NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
  sfc_g2_sc + theme(legend.position = "none"), legend_g2, sfc_g2_cb + theme(legend.position = "none"), NULL, NULL, NULL,
  NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL,
  sfc_g3_sc + theme(legend.position = "none"), legend_g3, sfc_g3_cb + theme(legend.position = "none"), NULL, NULL, NULL,
  labels = c("A", "", "", "", "", "",
             "", "", "", "", "", "",
             "B", "", "", "", "", "",
             "", "", "", "", "", "",
             "C", "", "", "", "", "",
             "", "", "", "", "", "",
             "D", "", "", "", "", "",
             "", "", "", "", "", "",
             "E", "", "", "", "", ""),
  label_size = 12,
  rel_widths = c(1, 0.25, 1, 0.1, 1, 0.25),
  rel_heights = c(1, 0.1, 1, 0.1, 1, 0.1, 1),
  ncol = 6,
  align = "v")

setwd("../publications/figures")

cowplot::set_null_device(cairo_pdf)
ggsave(
  pca_all,
  filename = "figure_3.pdf",
  device = cairo_pdf,
  height = 20,
  width = 22,
  units = "cm",
  bg = "transparent",
  dpi = "print"
)

tiff(
  "figure_3.tiff",
  height = 20,
  width = 20,
  units = "cm",
  compression = "lzw",
  res = 500,
  type = "cairo",
  bg = "white"
)
pca_all
dev.off()
```
